$comment: Machine-readable component contracts for the Wyrd design system. `status: built` entries are implemented in src/lib/components and registered in src/lib/registry.ts (parity enforced by registry.test.ts); the rendered reference is ./wyrd-ui-source-of-truth.html. A dynamic-layout/A2UI renderer consumes this file to compose UIs from standardized pieces. Infrastructure (ModeProvider, Drawer) is intentionally absent: it is composed by other components, not placed by name.

altitudes.quiet: workbench default — 3px hard-offset shadow, restrained accent
altitudes.loud: hero / landing only — 10px shadow, tricolor rail, display type

rules: 2px border always
3px shadow quiet / 6px shadow raised
5px radius
wide spans grid-column 1 / -1
primary = lime fill (the one strong action)
rune = brand violet fill
ghost = surface fill, no accent
press interaction: hover lifts to 5px, active sinks to 1px
tone is a status signal, not decoration
2px border in tone color, 12% tinted fill, 4px radius
header is white surface (not gray) relying on the 2px bottom border
selection wash uses --rune-soft (tr.sel), never lime
2px row dividers, last row borderless
delta trend up = --ok, down = --danger
min-width:0 + overflow:hidden so wide values never blow out a grid track
inline SVG, bar fill from a kind/line token, value + category labels
multi-series, dashed gridlines, series stroke from kind tokens (e.g. p50 blue / p95 violet / p99 red)
90x24 polyline, no fill, color = trend sentiment
grouped reference (control) vs current (violet) distribution bars
line with dashed danger threshold; points above threshold turn danger
intensity ramp uses violet (--rune-strong), NEVER lime — lime can't darken on white
stacked plane distribution using the Line colors + legend
native details/summary, 3px kind left-bar on leaves, dashed nested guide
2px border menu, 3px shadow, selected option rune-soft wash + rune-strong tick
mono surface-2 block, 2px border, 5px radius
optional copy button via navigator.clipboard
op left-bar by span kind (agent=client, llm=violet, tool=server, retrieval=control); status column ok/warn/err
raw values in (durationMs/tokens/cost numbers, score 0-1, scoreTone verdict); formatted internally via lib/format.ts
ruler + positioned span bars; bar = kind border + color-mix kind tint; error overrides to danger
raised drawer, top-bar = span kind color, kv attributes + event timeline + code preview
token counts are raw numbers, humanized via lib/format.ts
raised drawer, big score, metric bars vs threshold (ok/danger), judge rationale
raised drawer, top-bar turns --danger when drifted (status overrides kind), histogram + trend
212px sidebar + topbar + main grid; 3px outer border
nav groups; active item rune-soft wash + border + 2px shadow; lime brand dot
breadcrumb + search + env pill with status dot
display type, 3px border, 10px shadow, tricolor rail; landing only, never beside the workbench
